matched_controls.matching: Up to three different issuers with score >=60, score difference <=15, same current SIC division, prior nominal price within factor 2 and prior 20-session dollar volume within factor 3. Exclude known reverse-split dates within 30 calendar days. Sort by pre-entry distance then ticker. Matching never uses future returns.
matched_controls.universe: Historical nominal ticker histories with resolved issuer in the event catalogue. Different issuer; no catalogued split within +/-30 days. Partial, event-derived control pool; not the whole market.
matched_controls.limitations: Uses current SIC division and retrospectively excludes future splits for a diagnostic comparison. Historical ticker/security class and unobserved actions remain incomplete. No causal or executable alpha claim.

exit_reconciliation.policy: Every earlier residual path retained. Actual loan termination remains unknown without dated broker evidence; missing prices never create a zero-price cover.

borrow_economics.basis: Source-backed dated broker statements replace scenario fees on their effective dates. Quotes remain quoted economics; public indications never confer approval. Unsupplied dates retain explicit sensitivity assumptions.

issuer_interval.method: 95% percentile interval; whole-issuer bootstrap; observed trades only, not future book returns

year_interval.method: 95% percentile interval; whole-issuer bootstrap; observed trades only, not future book returns

current_borrow_sensitivities.assumption: Equal weight per currently quoted available name. Current symbol matching is not a historical security master. Missing rates are not zero. Flat-rate sensitivities apply current population rates across history; the cap illustration additionally filters on current inventory/rates and is not a tradable historical backtest.

protocol.entry: Next exchange session after a verified reverse split, at the open; action public before entry. Skip observed SSR rather than delay. Unknown status fails the executable gate.
protocol.exit: Same session close. Record partial fills, recalls and delayed exits; keep liabilities until a sourced cover and broker loan return. No assumed stop fill.
protocol.approval: Require dated security identity, margin schedule, written thesis, entry quote, approved locate reference, quantity and quoted annual fee. Public inventory is an indication only.
protocol.costs: One minimum borrowing day on rounded collateral; replace assumptions with dated broker fees when supplied. Entry spread, slippage and commission plus an equal exit-cost estimate must total no more than 1% of notional. Record actual fees and covers afterward.
protocol.controls: Up to three different issuers with score >=60, score difference <=15, same current SIC division, prior nominal price within factor 2 and prior 20-session dollar volume within factor 3. Exclude known reverse-split dates within 30 calendar days. Sort by pre-entry distance then ticker. Matching never uses future returns.
protocol.review: First review after at least 100 completed events and 60 issuers, with complete cost/exit records; descriptive interim updates only. Rules change only in a new version/cohort. This threshold is a review gate, not proof of representativeness.

forward_validation.costs_basis: Imported actual fills, borrow paid and commissions; spread/slippage embedded in fills. Locate reference required. Loan settlement separately audited.

limits: No OTC prices or historical borrow are supplied by this action list
Publication-day clock is conservative; exact dissemination is not established
Automated source matching requires event and security-class adjudication; unresolved candidates stay visible
OTC actions are included even when historical prices are unavailable
Historical borrow permission, actual quotes, recalls, dividends and terminal obligations are incomplete
Official listing-venue auctions benchmark entry/exit; missing auctions remain unavailable
Historical financial facts use filing dates; issuer industry classification still uses current SEC metadata
Volume covers three exchanges across all sessions; it is not consolidated regular-session liquidity
No recent venue print can reflect a rename, halt or delisting; terminal status requires adjudication
Conditional account results are assumptions; no performance-based threshold selection or Sharpe claim
Every cohort reports its own events and issuers; multiple entry settings do not multiply the sample
A missing exit is unavailable or an unresolved liability; it is never a zero-return trade
